[quote=lavinsworth_united_islands;60012481]What?

1. We would trade steel with you if we can cut you off in the event you begin trading with Techno or Oceanice. That's not being neutral, that willfully making a deal with a warmonger or a fascist regime.

2. I literally never said I would not trade with you for being neutral. If you want to be neutral, don't trade with either side.

3. Oceanice isn't in a war, but is a long time rival of my nation. Expecting me to continue trading with you what you are open to signing a deal with a fascist regime that I've had a cold war with for almost 100 years now is like expecting Serbia and Kosovo to sign a friendship agreement.

4. The IPEA is an alliance which aims to mediate conflicts, as stated in Article III of the Constitution of IPEA. Trading with either side of the conflict would violate Article III part C, which states "No IPEA member may take a position that biases them in favor of one side of the conflict that IPEA is trying to end, nor may they be provided military aid or support to any of the parties of the conflict." This would be a violation of Article III part C as a trade deal with nations on either side of a war could influence that nation's decision making such as hoping to keep the trade deal of obtaining better conditions in said deal by trying to sway other IPEA members to the side that nation has a trade deal with. Doesn't sound very neutral to me.

5. In Article VIII of the Constitution of IPEA, the fundamental rights of all citizens inside of members of the IPEA is defined as "All people in IPEA nations have a fundamental right to life, security, property, choice of religion, political party, and opinion, and the right to peacefully assemble in protest, peacefully criticize their government or any other government, and peacefully express their opinions and views in public and in media." Trading with Oceanice, a nation which has no freedom of press, right to peacefully assemble in protest, right to peacefully criticize their government, right to peacefully express their opinions and views in public and in media, choice of religion, political party, and opinion would be a blatant spit in the face to IPEA values.

Tell me [nation]Western View[/nation], does the IPEA care about all, or simply ensuring the freedom of their own while profiting off the oppression and systematic killing of others?
[nation]Baladullah[/nation] What do you think about letting someone into the IPEA who has no qualms about trading with a fascist regime?[/quote]
